handoffs.message: Ready for review: added PersonaAllocationProposal JSON Schema plus dataclass/API validation alignment. Task-owned files: services/optimizer-svc/portfolio_synthesis/persona_allocation_proposal.schema.json, services/optimizer-svc/test_persona_allocation_proposal_schema.py, services/optimizer-svc/portfolio_synthesis/models.py, services/optimizer-svc/portfolio_synthesis/__init__.py, services/optimizer-svc/main.py. Verification: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest services/optimizer-svc/test_persona_allocation_proposal_schema.py -> 6 passed; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s services/optimizer-svc -p 'test_*.py' -> 13 passed; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 services/optimizer-svc/smoke_test_portfolio_synthesis.py -> 3/3 smoke groups passed; py_compile optimizer-svc files passed. Note: due concurrent workspace staging, these schema files landed in commit abe1da51 alongside an OODA fix rather than an isolated MGMT-SYN-001 commit; no history rewrite attempted.

Review blocked: PersonaAllocationProposal schema/dataclass/API validation are not aligned. Required changes: (1) API/dataclass path must enforce schema-required fields instead of accepting omitted fields through defaults; omitted created_at is currently accepted and auto-created via ProposalIn.model_dump(exclude_none=True) -> PersonaAllocationProposal. (2) dataclass validation must either enforce schema constraints for directions uniqueItems and target_weights key pattern ^[A-Za-z0-9._:/-]+$, or intentionally relax the schema with matching tests. (3) add regression tests for omitted created_at through the API/model path, duplicate directions, and invalid target_weight keys. Reviewer verification passed existing tests: schema unittest 6 passed; optimizer-svc unittest discover 13 passed; portfolio smoke 3/3; py_compile passed.

Ready for re-review: aligned PersonaAllocationProposal API/dataclass path with schema-required fields by making target_type, directions, target_weights, conviction, uncertainty, evidence_refs, and created_at required; dataclass now enforces duplicate-free directions and target_weights key pattern ^[A-Za-z0-9._:/-]+$; added regressions for omitted created_at through FastAPI, duplicate directions, and invalid target_weight keys. Task-owned files: services/optimizer-svc/portfolio_synthesis/models.py, services/optimizer-svc/main.py, services/optimizer-svc/test_persona_allocation_proposal_schema.py, services/optimizer-svc/test_portfolio_synthesis.py, services/optimizer-svc/smoke_test_portfolio_synthesis.py. Verification: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest services/optimizer-svc/test_persona_allocation_proposal_schema.py -> 9 passed; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s services/optimizer-svc -p 'test_*.py' -> 16 passed; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 services/optimizer-svc/smoke_test_portfolio_synthesis.py -> 3/3 smoke groups passed; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest services/optimizer-svc/test_persona_allocation_proposal_store.py -q -> 6 passed; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m py_compile optimizer-svc touched files -> passed.
